_source: First-party: ben-cole-niche-details.txt + ben-cole-one-pager.txt (Drive, 2026-07-23). Supersedes web-only v1, which wrongly widened the ICP to regulated B2B SaaS generally and used prose disqualifiers that never matched.
niche_statement: Fractional technical-operations executive for US-based funded PC/console game studios of roughly 20-150 people entering full production, owning the non-creative operations layer (DevOps, cloud, build/release, IT, security, vendors) so senior engineers and the Tech Director stay on the game.
edp: Milestone confidence: every week senior engineers and the Tech Director spend on builds, access, cloud, vendors and release fire drills is runway burned against a publisher-fixed milestone date - miss the milestone and the funding tranche or launch window goes with it.
expertise_statements: we are entering full production and need someone to own our build and release pipeline
our senior engineers spend most of their time on infrastructure instead of the game
we need a first DevOps engineer to take builds over from the engineering team
our technical director is doing IT, cloud and vendor management on top of the game
we need someone to own studio cloud infrastructure and cost management
build times are blocking the whole team and nobody owns the build system
we need to set up identity, access and security for a fast growing studio
our publisher is asking security and operational questions we cannot answer
we need release coordination and live operations readiness before launch
we are scaling headcount fast with no IT or onboarding process
we need someone to own studio tooling, Perforce and pipeline automation
we need QA automation and a repeatable console certification submission process
we have no dedicated security owner and we handle player data
our backend and live services grew with no operations owner
we need vendor and outsourcer governance across multiple projects
we need a first platform hire and do not know what they should own
